|translation='''Title:''' I've come to help.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use if you have a spy at Detention Block Corridor. Draw destiny. If destiny + the spy's ability > the captive's ability, release that captive. Otherwise the spy is captured.

2: Cancel Spice Mines Of Kessel (releasing the targeted captive).

'''Lore:'''
“Huh?”
